proposals.evidence: Turner lists Punjabi bahārī/buhārī and Lahnda bohārī broom, with Prakrit baühārī/bōhārī and Gujarati bārvũ sweep. The contracted bāh-/bhā-rī survey forms fit this northwestern and western broom family.
